purpose: One-shot shape-only diagnostic: hold each Taylor-row AOD550 and default aerosol optical properties fixed while replacing only the aerosol optical-depth vertical distribution with a normalized NOAA HRRR-Smoke mass-density shape.

hrrr.profileConstruction: For each 01:00 and 02:00 UTC analysis, join hybrid-level HGT and MASSDEN by level; define AGL height as HGT minus hybrid-level-1 HGT for that time; retain exactly 50 hybrid levels; linearly interpolate density in AGL height and then in time to each Taylor row. Integrate rho dz within each AFGLUS altitude layer above the 0.262-km observer. Use those layer masses only as a relative vertical-shape proxy, normalize the above-observer profile, and then apply the already-frozen row AOD550.
hrrr.columnSanity: The underlying 50-level trapezoidal rho dz integral was independently checked against HRRR COLMD before this experiment and agreed to about 0.02-0.24 percent at 00/01/02 UTC.
hrrr.interpretation: HRRR smoke is a vertical-shape proxy only. This diagnostic does not claim that all aerosol was smoke, that smoke mass is a calibrated extinction coefficient, or that this is the exact CAMS total-aerosol profile.

comparison.primaryDiagnostic: deltaMag550=-2.5*log10(Q_hrrr_shape/Q_default_vertical); positive means the HRRR-shaped aerosol makes modeled twilight darker at 550 nm
comparison.broadbandOrientationOnly: For orientation only, deltaMag550 may be added to the previously frozen broadband SQM model magnitude. This is not a replacement broadband forward calculation or validation.

stopping: Run exactly the frozen 10 rows once at GitHub run attempt 1. No retry/re-run under this identity, no AOD fitting, no profile scaling to Taylor, no row deletion, no threshold change, and no result-dependent follow-up under this identity.
